<summary>🤖 Prompt for all review comments with AI agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

Inline comments:
In `@docs/content/recipes/common/acm-mce-hypershift-operator-overrides.md`:
- Line 108: The verification command uses -o jsonpath which emits Python-style
strings that jq cannot parse; replace the jsonpath output with full JSON and use
a jq selector to extract the args field instead — run kubectl with -o json and
pipe to jq '.spec.template.spec.containers[0].args' (targeting the deployment
named operator in namespace hypershift) so jq receives valid JSON and can
correctly print the containers[0].args value.
```

</details>
